Cocoa Krispies ~ “Brownies”!!!
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Tuesday, March 27, 2012 - 8:45am

Ingredients




6 cups Cocoa Krispies Cereal
4 cups mini marshmallows
½ cup whole almonds
½ cup shredded coconut
¼ cup chocolate chips
4 tablespoons butter

Preparation

1 In a food processor combine the almonds, shredded coconut and chocolate chips. Give a few good chops, leaving the mixture slightly coarse. 2 In a large frying pan melt the butter over a gentle heat. Add the marshmallows and begin to melt them. 3 Add the Cocoa Krispies and the mixture from the food processor and toss. 4 Butter a baking pan and smooth the mixture in the pan. 5 Preheat Oven 350 degrees: 6 Bake for 5-6 minutes to completely set this mixture. 7 Let this completely cool before slicing.

About

What a fun and delicious dessert.
With Love,
Catherine
xo
